description: This Kotlin source file defines the NotesViewModel class, which manages notes data for a notes Android app, including search, theme, add/update, and delete functionalities, as well as a ViewModel factory.

classes.name: NotesViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing notes data, search queries, and theme settings for the notes app.

classes.name: NotesViewModelFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of NotesViewModel with dependency injection.

methods.name: setSearchQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query used to filter notes.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Toggles the theme between dark and light mode.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the theme to dark or light based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: addOrUpdateNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note or updates an existing one based on the note's ID.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID asynchronously.

methods.name: create
